description_en: Creates an LLM gateway API key for an application instance
description_zh: 应用实例创建 LLM 网关 API-KEY
kebab_example: aliyun websitebuild create-app-llm-api-key-for-partner --biz-id WD20250814102215000001 --ip-white-list 0.0.0.0 --description success --client-token xxxxx-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAppLlmApiKeyForPartner

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the application instance
parameters.name: biz_id

parameters.help_en: The custom IP address whitelist defined by the invoker. The system default IP ranges are appended by the backend
parameters.help_zh: 调用方自定义 IP 白名单（后端追加系统默认 IP 段）
parameters.name: ip_white_list

parameters.help_en: The description of the API key usage
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. This parameter is reserved for future use
parameters.name: client_token
